raw_comment:
1.  States with the worst drought correlate with Trump voters who deny climate change.
2.  Since all colors refer to *some* level of drought, I wonder what the colors really mean.  Why is the entire nation in some kind of drought?  And are the coasts more immune to drought because of their proximity to the ocean?
3.  For my own community (NH) it means as usual we live in a bubble divorced from the bulk of the US in terms of climate as well as everything else.
4.  Title:  "Drought aims at red states despite denials of global warming."
